transcript.text: Hello, I'm here to help you get ready for your appointment. Could you tell me what has been bothering you?
I'm not going to the toilet like I used to.
Can you tell me when you first noticed this change?
About three weeks ago, I think.
Do you have any allergies, or have you ever had a bad reaction to a medicine?
No, I've never had a bad reaction to anything.
How much is this change getting in the way of your everyday life?
My granddaughter comes round every Sunday, she's a dear.
Could you tell me about any medicines you take, including any you’ve started or changed recently, and the dose if you know it?
Started co-codamol about a month ago, two tablets four times a day.
Have you ever been told by a doctor that you have any long-term health condition?
I've got osteoarthritis in my spine and knees.
How much would you say this change in your toilet habits is affecting your day-to-day life — not at all, a little, a fair amount, or you're not sure?
The straining's uncomfortable, about a 4 out of 10.
Have you noticed any other symptoms along with this change in your toilet habits?
My lower tummy feels bloated.
What, if anything, makes your toilet habits worse?
I've been drinking less, so I don't get up at night.
What, if anything, worries you most about this change in your toilet habits?
I worry it could be something serious. Like cancer.
Besides the osteoarthritis in your spine and knees, is there anything else about your past health you'd like to share?
I have an irregular heartbeat, atrial fibrillation.
Besides the Co-codamol you mentioned, are there any other medicines you take regularly or have started or changed recently?
I take apixaban, twice a day.
How, if at all, has this change in your toilet habits affected your usual daily activities?
My son does the shopping now.
Other than your lower tummy feeling bloated, is there anything else you’ve noticed?
No blood in my stools.

Apart from the osteoarthritis and irregular heartbeat you mentioned, is there anything else about your past health, such as other long-term conditions, operations, or hospital stays, that you’d like to add?
No, that's all I can think of.
Besides the Co-codamol and Apixaban you mentioned, are there any other medicines you take, including anything you buy without a prescription?
I take bisoprolol once a day.
Apart from the bloated feeling and no blood in your stools, is there anything else you’ve noticed that you’d like to add?
My son keeps an eye on my tablets for me.
Thank you, that is very helpful. I have put together a short summary of what you told me. Please read it and tell me if anything should be corrected before it goes to your doctor.
